title: Architecture Audit
description: Result of checking a draft spec@1 against the workspace's persisted arch-model@1 for architectural fit — boundary violations, competing abstractions, and invariant conflicts. Produced by scribe:arch-auditor in check mode. Not a binding verdict; a fail routes back to scribe/draft-spec the same way an audit-spec fail does, under the same 2-round circuit breaker.

type.description: boundary-violation: spec implies a dependency running against a module's allowed direction. competing-abstraction: spec introduces a new type/interface for a concept the model already canonicalizes. invariant-conflict: spec conflicts with a modeled invariant. missing-model-coverage: spec touches an area the model doesn't describe — not itself a defect, but a gap worth noting.

location.description: File path or module name the issue concerns, if applicable

suggested_fix.description: The rewritten fix, not just a description of the problem

overall.description: pass only if no boundary-violation, competing-abstraction, or invariant-conflict issues exist. missing-model-coverage alone never fails the audit.

model_updates_suggested.description: Things noticed during the check that the model itself should learn (a new module, a new canonical abstraction) without triggering a full rebuild.
